author: Jonathan Edwards
subtitle_en: Mandatory Duty, Faithful Stewardship, and Bountiful Giving
subtitle_tet: Devér Obrigatóriu, Mordomia Fiel no Fó Ho Abundante

cards.section_heading_en: Introduction - Mandatory Duty of Giving to the Poor
cards.section_heading_tet: Introdusaun - Devér Obrigatóriu Atu Fó Ba Ema Kiak
cards.scripture_en: "Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need" (Deut 15:8).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ó tenke loke ó-nia liman luan ba nia, no fó empresta sufisiente ba ninia nesesidade" (Deuteronómio 15:8).
cards.body_en: Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need... because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works (Deut 15:7-10). Giving to the poor is mentioned in Scripture as one of the weightier and more essential duties of religion. It is not merely an optional act of kindness, but a strict and mandatory command required of all who profess the name of Christ.
cards.body_tet: Ó tenke loke ó-nia liman luan ba nia, no fó empresta sufisiente ba ninia nesesidade... tanba ho ida-ne'e mak NA'I ó-nia Maromak sei haraik bensaun ba ó iha ó-nia serbisu hotu (Deuteronómio 15:7-10). Fó ba ema kiak temi iha Eskritura nu'udar ida husi devér ne'ebé todan no esensiál liu iha relijiaun. Ida-ne'e la'ós de'it hahalok laran-di'ak opsionál ida, maibé mandamentu rigorozu no obrigatóriu ne'ebé ezije husi ema hotu ne'ebé konfesa naran Kristu nian.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Giving to the poor is not an optional kindness, but an essential command required of all who confess Christ.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fó ba ema kiak la'ós laran-di'ak opsionál ida, maibé mandamentu esensiál ne'ebé ezije husi ema hotu ne'ebé konfesa Kristu.

cards.section_heading_tet: Fraternidade Universál no Ezemplu Kristu Nian
cards.scripture_en: "Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren" (1 John 3:16).
cards.scripture_tet: "Hodi ida-ne'e mak ita hatene domin Maromak nian, tanba Nia fó Ninia moris ba ita: no ita tenke fó ita-nia moris ba maun-alin no feton-laen sira" (1 João 3:16).
cards.body_en: We are all part of one human family created by God. Selfishness directly contradicts the relational nature of human society and the sacrificial example of Christ. Did not Christ give Himself entirely for us when we were wretched, poor, and undeserving? How can we claim to have the love of God dwelling in us if we close our hearts against our needy brother?
cards.body_tet: Ita hotu parte ida husi família umanu ida ne'ebé Maromak kria. Egoizmu kontra direitamente natureza relasionál sosiedade umanu nian no ezemplu sakrifisiál Kristu nian. Kristu la fó Ninia aan tomak ba ita bainhira ita kiak, terus no la merese ka? Oinsá mak ita bele dehan katak ita iha domin Maromak nian hela iha ita se ita taka ita-nia fuan hasoru ita-nia maun ka alin ne'ebé presiza?
cards.key_takeaway_en: Since Christ gave Himself for unworthy sinners, believers cannot close their hearts to a needy neighbor.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Tanba Kristu fó Ninia aan ba ema sala-na'in ne'ebé la merese, fiar-na'in sira la bele taka sira-nia fuan ba viziñu ne'ebé presiza.

cards.section_heading_en: Stewards, Not Absolute Owners of Wealth
cards.section_heading_tet: Mordomu Sira, La'ós Na'in Absolutu Rikusoin Nian
cards.scripture_en: "The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof" (Psa 24:1).
cards.scripture_tet: "Rai mak NA'I nian, no buat hotu ne'ebé nakonu iha laran" (Salmu 24:1).
cards.body_en: Personal possessions are not our absolute property, but resources entrusted to us as faithful stewards. God is the sovereign owner of all things. When He commands us to give to the poor, He is simply directing us how to distribute His own goods for the relief of His needy creatures. To withhold from the poor is to rob God of His right.
cards.body_tet: Sasán pesoál la'ós ita-nia propriedade absoluta, maibé rekursu ne'ebé entrega mai ita nu'udar mordomu fiél sira. Maromak mak na'in soberanu ba buat hotu. Bainhira Nia haruka ita atu fó ba ema kiak, Nia simples mente dirije ita oinsá atu distribui Ninia sasán rasik ba alíviu Ninia kriatura sira ne'ebé presiza. Hamenus ba ema kiak mak na'ok Maromak nia direitu.
cards.key_takeaway_en: We are stewards, not owners, of our wealth; withholding from the needy robs God of what belongs to Him.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Ita mak mordomu, la'ós na'in, ba ita-nia rikusoin; hamenus ba sira ne'ebé presiza na'ok Maromak nia buat ne'ebé Ninian.

cards.section_heading_en: Excuse Answered 1 - “I Worked Hard for My Money”
cards.section_heading_tet: Deskulpa Hatán 1 - "Ha'u Serbisu Maka'as Ba Ha'u-Nia Osan"
cards.scripture_en: "And thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth" (Deut 8:18).
cards.scripture_tet: "No ó tenke hanoin-hetan NA'I ó-nia Maromak: tanba Nia mak fó kbiit ba ó atu hetan rikusoin" (Deuteronómio 8:18).
cards.body_en: Some object: I earned this by my own industry and labor. But who gave you the health, strength, and opportunity to acquire wealth? Was it not God? Furthermore, God commands you to use the fruit of your labor for His glory and the relief of the poor. To refuse to give because it is yours reveals an ungrateful, idolatrous heart that loves money more than God.
cards.body_tet: Balun kontra: Ha'u manán ida-ne'e liuhosi ha'u-nia industria no serbisu rasik. Maibé sé mak fó ba ó saúde, forsa no oportunidade atu hetan rikusoin? La'ós Maromak ka? Aleinde ne'e, Maromak haruka ó atu uza fuan husi ó-nia serbisu ba Ninia glória no alíviu ema kiak nian. Rekuza atu fó tanba ida-ne'e ó-nian hatudu fuan ida ne'ebé la agradese no idolatra ne'ebé hadomi osan liu fali Maromak.
cards.key_takeaway_en: God gives the strength and opportunity to earn; refusing to share for His glory and the poor betrays ingratitude.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Maromak fó forsa no oportunidade atu manán; rekuza fahe ba Ninia glória no ema kiak hatudu la agradese.

cards.section_heading_tet: Deskulpa Hatán 2 - "Ema Kiak Sira La Merese"
cards.scripture_en: "Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful" (Luke 6:36).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tanba ne'e imi sai laran-sadia, hanesan mós imi-nia Aman laran-sadia" (Lucas 6:36).
cards.body_en: Others object: The poor are foolish, ungrateful, or brought this poverty on themselves. But consider: did God wait until you were deserving before He showed mercy to you? Were you not an enemy, rebellious, and utterly unworthy when Christ died for you? If God dealt with us according to our desert, we should all be in hell. We must show mercy as God shows mercy.
cards.body_tet: Seluk kontra: Ema kiak sira beik, la agradese, ka lori kiak ne'e ba sira-nia aan rasik. Maibé konsidera: Maromak hein to'o ó merese antes Nia hatudu laran-sadia ba ó ka? Ó la'ós inimigu, rebelde no la merese hotu bainhira Kristu mate ba ó ka? Se Maromak trata ita tuir ita-nia merese, ita hotu sei iha infernu. Ita tenke hatudu laran-sadia hanesan Maromak hatudu laran-sadia.
cards.key_takeaway_en: God showed mercy to us while we were unworthy enemies; we must show mercy even when others fall short.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Maromak hatudu laran-sadia ba ita enkuantu ita inimigu la merese; ita tenke hatudu laran-sadia maski seluk la to'o.

cards.section_heading_en: Excuse Answered 3 - “I Might Become Poor Myself”
cards.section_heading_tet: Deskulpa Hatán 3 - "Ha'u Rasik Bele Sai Kiak"
cards.scripture_en: "He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again" (Prov 19:17).
cards.scripture_tet: "Ema ne'ebé iha laran-sadia ba ema kiak fó empresta ba NA'I; no buat ne'ebé nia fó, Nia sei selu fali ba nia" (Provérbios 19:17).
cards.body_en: Some fear that liberal giving will impoverish them. But Scripture explicitly promises the exact opposite: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again (Prov 19:17). There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth (Prov 11:24). Generous giving is the surest investment in God’s banking system.
cards.body_tet: Balun tauk katak fó ho laran-luak sei halo sira sai kiak. Maibé Eskritura promete ho klaru buat ne'ebé oin seluk: Ema ne'ebé iha laran-sadia ba ema kiak fó empresta ba NA'I; no buat ne'ebé nia fó, Nia sei selu fali ba nia (Provérbios 19:17). Iha ida ne'ebé fahe, no aumenta (Provérbios 11:24). Fó ho laran-luak mak investimentu ne'ebé seguru liu iha sistema bankáriu Maromak nian.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Giving to the poor lends to the Lord, who promises to repay and bless generous givers rather than impoverish them.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fó ba ema kiak fó empresta ba Na'i, ne'ebé promete atu selu fali no haraik bensaun ba sira ne'ebé fó ho laran-luak duké halo kiak.

cards.section_heading_en: Judgment Without Mercy for the Uncharitable
cards.section_heading_tet: Julgamentu Sein Laran-Sadia Ba Ema Ne'ebé La Iha Karidade
cards.scripture_en: "For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy" (Jas 2:13).
cards.scripture_tet: "Tanba nia sei simu julgamentu sein laran-sadia, ne'ebé la hatudu laran-sadia" (Tiago 2:13).
cards.body_en: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy (James 2:13). Uncharitableness invites divine judgment. A profession of faith without active, compassionate charity to the needy is dead and worthless. In the Great Day of Judgment, Christ will separate the sheep from the goats based on how they treated His needy brethren (Matt 25).
cards.body_tet: Tanba nia sei simu julgamentu sein laran-sadia, ne'ebé la hatudu laran-sadia (Tiago 2:13). Falta karidade konvida julgamentu divinu. Konfisaun fiar ida sein karidade ativa no kompaixaun ba sira ne'ebé presiza mate no la iha folin. Iha Loron Boot Julgamentu nian, Kristu sei haketak bibi-malae husi bibi-timur bazeia ba oinsá sira trata Ninia maun-alin no feton-laen sira ne'ebé presiza (Mateus 25).
cards.key_takeaway_en: A faith lacking compassionate care for the needy is dead and faces judgment without mercy.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Fiar ida ne'ebé falta kuidadu kompaixaun ba sira ne'ebé presiza mate no hasoru julgamentu sein laran-sadia.

cards.section_heading_en: Conclusion - Bountiful Giving for Eternal Rewards
cards.section_heading_tet: Konkluzaun - Fó Ho Abundante Ba Rekompensa Eternidade Nian
cards.scripture_en: "Lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt" (Matt 6:20).
cards.scripture_tet: "Rai ba imi-nia aan rikusoin sira iha lalehan, iha ne'ebé la iha tatedi ka ferrujen mak estraga" (Mateus 6:20).
cards.body_en: Therefore, open your hand wide to your poor brother! Give bountifully, willingly, and cheerfully. What you give to the poor for Christ’s sake is not lost; it is stored as eternal treasure in heaven where moth and rust do not corrupt. Compassionate generosity results in eternal heavenly rewards rather than earthly loss.
cards.body_tet: Tanba ne'e, loke ó-nia liman luan ba ó-nia maun ka alin kiak! Fó ho abundante, ho hakarak no ho ksolok. Saida mak ó fó ba ema kiak tanba Kristu la lakon; ida-ne'e rai nu'udar rikusoin eternidade nian iha lalehan iha ne'ebé tatedi ka ferrujen la estraga. Jenerozidade kompaixaun nian lori rekompensa lalehan nian ne'ebé rohan-laek duké lakon iha rai.
cards.key_takeaway_en: Open your hand cheerfully to the poor; giving for Christ's sake stores up imperishable treasure in heaven.
cards.key_takeaway_tet: Loke ó-nia liman ho ksolok ba ema kiak; fó tanba Kristu rai rikusoin ne'ebé la aat iha lalehan.
